```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

**Status: SUPPLEMENTARY and EXPLORATORY throughout.** In the paper this material is supplementary
(R5, "neighbor response"; Fig S-fava = `Fig_FavaNeighbor_InocWater` and
`Fig_FavaNeighbor_PotComposition`), not a main figure. None of this is in the pre-specified confirmatory set, and every
p-value and CI is unadjusted for multiplicity. This file replaces the earlier fava documents
(14 Fig 3 "fava suppression", 16 "competitive balance", 18 "fava as explanatory", 19 "AMF vs fava").
Those were built on a data-entry error: the fava weights for the sterile intercrop pots (31-45) were
a copy of the wheat berry weights. With the corrected weights (Nov 2026), the earlier "inoculation
suppresses fava" result does not hold.

**Three questions, all on the 30 intercrop pots.**

1. Does wheat inoculation change fava biomass, and does that depend on water?
2. Does inoculation change the competitive balance (wheat vs fava) or the pot's total biomass?
3. Does fava biomass, as a measured (non-randomized) covariate, track wheat performance?

**Conventions.** The randomized `Inoc` factor is the predictor in Parts 1-2. Every model is fitted
**once** on all 30 intercrop pots and conditioned within with `emmeans` (no subset models). Effects
are `Inoc - Strl` with 95% CIs, n = 5 pots per cell. Wheat biomass is the **pot total** for the 6
wheat plants (`W_NPP`). There is one fava plant per pot, so per-pot and per-plant fava biomass are
the same number. Fava roots were not stained, so fava's own colonization is unknown: "inoculation"
here always means *wheat's* randomized inoculation treatment.

```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(patchwork)
source("../fig_style.R")

inter <- readRDS("../wheat_audited.rds") %>% filter(Poly == "Inter") %>%
  mutate(wheat = W_NPP, fava = Fava_g, pot = Pot_NPP_g,
         log_fava = log(fava), log_wheat = log(wheat), log_pot = log(pot),
         log_ratio = log(wheat / fava))
stopifnot(nrow(inter) == 30, all(table(inter$Inoc, inter$Water) == 5),
          identical(levels(inter$Inoc), c("Inoc", "Strl")), all(inter$Num_fava == 1),
          all(inter$fava > 0), all(inter$wheat > 0),
          isTRUE(all.equal(inter$fava, inter$fava_npp)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(inter$pot, inter$wheat + inter$fava, tolerance = 1e-4)))  # pot = wheat + fava

# ---- formatting helpers for inline text --------------------------------------------------------
fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(p < 1e-4, "< 0.0001", paste("=", signif(p, 2)))   # use as "p `r fmt_p(x)`"
sgn    <- function(x, d = 0) gsub("-", "−", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, flag = "+"), fixed = TRUE)
ci_txt <- function(lo, hi, d = 0, unit = "") paste0(sgn(lo, d), unit, " to ", sgn(hi, d), unit)
clear  <- function(lo, hi) lo > 0 | hi < 0                                     # CI excludes zero
```

# 1. Fava biomass by wheat inoculation and water (EXPLORATORY)

## Raw cell means

```{r means}
means <- inter %>% group_by(Water, Inoc) %>%
  summarise(fava = mean(fava), wheat = mean(wheat), pot = mean(pot), .groups = "drop")
means_wide <- means %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Inoc, values_from = c(fava, wheat, pot)) %>%
  transmute(Water, fava_Inoc, fava_Strl, d_fava = fava_Inoc - fava_Strl,
            d_wheat = wheat_Inoc - wheat_Strl, d_pot = pot_Inoc - pot_Strl,
            pot_pct = (pot_Inoc / pot_Strl - 1) * 100)
knitr::kable(means_wide %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))),
             col.names = c("Water", "fava, Inoc (g)", "fava, Strl (g)", "Δ fava (g)", "Δ wheat (g)",
                           "Δ total pot (g)", "Δ total pot (%)"),
             caption = "Raw cell means and differences (Inoc - Strl), grams per pot")
```

## Variance check

```{r variance}
resp <- tribble(~var,        ~label,
                "log_fava",  "log(fava)",
                "log_wheat", "log(wheat, pot total)",
                "log_pot",   "log(total pot)",
                "log_ratio", "log(wheat : fava)")
cell <- interaction(inter$Inoc, inter$Water)
vtab <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(resp)), function(i)
  tibble(response = resp$label[i],
         `Levene, 6 cells (p)` = car::leveneTest(inter[[resp$var[i]]], cell, center = median)[1, "Pr(>F)"]))
knitr::kable(vtab %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))),
             caption = "Variance homogeneity across the six Inoc x Water cells (Levene, median-centered)")
lev_min <- min(vtab$`Levene, 6 cells (p)`)
```

The smallest Levene p-value across the four responses is `r round(lev_min, 2)`, so the models below
assume equal variance.

## Effects

```{r effects}
get_eff <- function(var, label, scale = c("log", "identity")) {
  scale <- match.arg(scale)
  m <- lm(reformulate("Inoc * Water", var), data = inter)
  a <- car::Anova(m, type = 2)
  s <- emmeans(m, ~ Inoc | Water) %>% contrast("pairwise", by = "Water", adjust = "none") %>%
    summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>% as.data.frame()
  stopifnot(all(s$contrast == "Inoc - Strl"))
  tibble(response = label, Water = factor(s$Water, levels(inter$Water)),
         est = s$estimate, lo = s$lower.CL, hi = s$upper.CL, p = s$p.value,
         p_inoc = a["Inoc", "Pr(>F)"], p_water = a["Water", "Pr(>F)"],
         p_interaction = a["Inoc:Water", "Pr(>F)"], scale = scale)
}
log_eff <- bind_rows(
  get_eff("log_fava",  "Fava biomass",              "log"),
  get_eff("log_wheat", "Wheat biomass (pot total)", "log"),
  get_eff("log_pot",   "Total pot biomass",         "log"),
  get_eff("log_ratio", "Wheat : fava ratio",        "log")) %>%
  mutate(fold = exp(est), fold_lo = exp(lo), fold_hi = exp(hi),
         pct = (fold - 1) * 100, pct_lo = (fold_lo - 1) * 100, pct_hi = (fold_hi - 1) * 100)

gram_eff <- bind_rows(
  get_eff("fava",  "Fava biomass",              "identity"),
  get_eff("wheat", "Wheat biomass (pot total)", "identity"),
  get_eff("pot",   "Total pot biomass",         "identity"))

knitr::kable(log_eff %>% filter(response != "Wheat : fava ratio") %>%
               transmute(response, Water, `% change` = round(pct, 1),
                         `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.1f, %.1f]", pct_lo, pct_hi), p = signif(p, 2),
                         `Inoc x Water p` = signif(p_interaction, 2)),
             caption = "EXPLORATORY - Inoc - Strl effect, % change (log-scale models; unadjusted 95% CI)")
knitr::kable(gram_eff %>% transmute(response, Water, `difference (g per pot)` = round(est, 2),
                                    `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", lo, hi), p = signif(p, 2)),
             caption = "EXPLORATORY - the same contrasts in grams per pot (identity-scale models)")

dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(log_eff,  "outputs/fava_neighbor_effects_log.csv",   row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gram_eff, "outputs/fava_neighbor_effects_grams.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# values used in the text
fl <- log_eff  %>% filter(response == "Fava biomass")
fg <- gram_eff %>% filter(response == "Fava biomass")
fl_c <- fl %>% filter(Water == "Control"); fl_m <- fl %>% filter(Water == "Moderate"); fl_s <- fl %>% filter(Water == "Severe")
fg_s <- fg %>% filter(Water == "Severe")
n_clear_fava <- sum(clear(fl$lo, fl$hi))
```

**What the fava data show.** In the log-scale model of fava biomass the main effect of inoculation is
p `r fmt_p(fl$p_inoc[1])`, water p `r fmt_p(fl$p_water[1])`, and the inoculation x water interaction
p `r fmt_p(fl$p_interaction[1])`. Fava biomass with inoculated vs sterile wheat changed by
`r sgn(fl_c$pct)`% (95% CI `r ci_txt(fl_c$pct_lo, fl_c$pct_hi, unit = "%")`, p `r fmt_p(fl_c$p)`) at control,
`r sgn(fl_m$pct)`% (`r ci_txt(fl_m$pct_lo, fl_m$pct_hi, unit = "%")`, p `r fmt_p(fl_m$p)`) at moderate, and
`r sgn(fl_s$pct)`% (`r ci_txt(fl_s$pct_lo, fl_s$pct_hi, unit = "%")`, p `r fmt_p(fl_s$p)`) at severe water.
In grams, the severe-drought difference is `r sgn(fg_s$est, 2)` g per pot (95% CI
`r ci_txt(fg_s$lo, fg_s$hi, 2, " g")`, p `r fmt_p(fg_s$p)`). `r n_clear_fava` of the three per-water
contrasts has a CI that excludes zero.

**How to read it.** There is no evidence that wheat inoculation *suppressed* fava. The one
contrast that stands out is at severe drought, where fava was larger next to inoculated wheat. That is a
single cell with n = 5 pots per group, the interaction itself is not significant at 0.05, and the
contrast is unadjusted, so treat it as a lead to follow up and not as a finding.

# 2. Competitive balance and total pot biomass (EXPLORATORY)

```{r balance}
knitr::kable(log_eff %>% filter(response == "Wheat : fava ratio") %>%
               transmute(Water, `fold-change in wheat:fava ratio` = round(fold, 2),
                         `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", fold_lo, fold_hi), p = signif(p, 2),
                         `Inoc x Water p` = signif(p_interaction, 2)),
             caption = "EXPLORATORY - fold-change in the wheat:fava ratio with inoculation (1 = no change)")

wl <- log_eff %>% filter(response == "Wheat biomass (pot total)")
pl <- log_eff %>% filter(response == "Total pot biomass")
rl <- log_eff %>% filter(response == "Wheat : fava ratio")
pg <- gram_eff %>% filter(response == "Total pot biomass")
n_clear_bal <- sum(clear(wl$lo, wl$hi)) + sum(clear(pl$lo, pl$hi)) + sum(clear(rl$lo, rl$hi))
```

* **Wheat biomass (pot total).** Changes with inoculation of `r paste0(sgn(wl$pct), "%", collapse = ", ")`
  at control, moderate and severe water (p `r paste(signif(wl$p, 2), collapse = ", ")`).
* **Total pot biomass.** Changes of `r paste0(sgn(pg$est, 1), " g", collapse = ", ")` per pot
  (`r paste0(sgn(pl$pct), "%", collapse = ", ")`; p `r paste(signif(pl$p, 2), collapse = ", ")`);
  inoculation x water p `r fmt_p(pl$p_interaction[1])`.
* **Wheat : fava ratio.** Fold-changes of `r paste(sprintf("%.2f", rl$fold), collapse = ", ")`
  (p `r paste(signif(rl$p, 2), collapse = ", ")`).

Of these nine contrasts, `r n_clear_bal` have a CI that excludes zero. With n = 5 per cell the
competitive balance and the pot's total productivity show no detectable response to inoculation at
any water level. Wheat pot-level biomass is noisy, so "no detectable change" is the claim, and not "no change".

# 3. Fava biomass as a covariate for wheat biomass (EXPLORATORY, non-causal)

Fava biomass is not randomized. It is an outcome of the pot (water, inoculation, and whatever else
varied), so its relationship with wheat is a correlation between two plants sharing one pot, not an
effect of fava on wheat. Model: `log(W_NPP) ~ Fava_g * Water`, fitted once on all 30 pots, with the
fava slope in each water level from `emtrends` (log scale, so a slope of −0.1 is about −10% wheat
biomass per extra gram of fava). The **adjusted** version adds `Inoc`.

```{r covariate}
m_pool <- lm(log(W_NPP) ~ Fava_g * Water, data = inter)
m_adj  <- lm(log(W_NPP) ~ Fava_g * Water + Inoc, data = inter)
sl <- function(m, kind) as.data.frame(summary(emtrends(m, ~ Water, var = "Fava_g"), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
  transmute(Water = factor(Water, levels(inter$Water)), kind, slope = Fava_g.trend, SE,
            lo = lower.CL, hi = upper.CL, p = p.value)
slopes <- bind_rows(sl(m_pool, "pooled"), sl(m_adj, "adjusted for Inoc"))
p_fw <- car::Anova(m_pool, type = 2)["Fava_g:Water", "Pr(>F)"]
r_by_water <- inter %>% group_by(Water) %>%
  summarise(`r(fava, Inoc)` = round(cor(Fava_g, Inoc == "Inoc"), 2),
            `fava range (g)` = sprintf("%.1f-%.1f", min(Fava_g), max(Fava_g)), .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(r_by_water, caption = "Fava vs inoculation within each water level (collinearity check)")
knitr::kable(slopes %>% arrange(Water, kind) %>%
               mutate(across(c(slope, SE, lo, hi), ~ round(.x, 3)), p = signif(p, 2)),
             caption = "EXPLORATORY - slope of log(wheat biomass per pot) on fava biomass (g), by water")
write.csv(slopes, "outputs/fava_covariate_slopes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

s_best <- slopes %>% filter(kind == "pooled") %>% slice_min(p, n = 1)
# sensitivity: drop the single most influential pot for that water level's slope
inf <- inter %>% mutate(cd = cooks.distance(m_pool)) %>% filter(Water == s_best$Water) %>% slice_max(cd, n = 1)
m_drop <- lm(log(W_NPP) ~ Fava_g * Water, data = filter(inter, Pot != inf$Pot))
s_drop <- sl(m_drop, "drop1") %>% filter(Water == s_best$Water)
s_best_adj <- slopes %>% filter(kind != "pooled", Water == s_best$Water)
n_clear_sl <- sum(clear(slopes$lo[slopes$kind == "pooled"], slopes$hi[slopes$kind == "pooled"]))
```

The fava x water interaction on log wheat biomass is p `r fmt_p(p_fw)`. `r n_clear_sl` of the three
pooled slopes has a CI that excludes zero: at `r tolower(as.character(s_best$Water))` water, pots with more fava
had less wheat biomass (slope `r sgn(s_best$slope, 2)` per g, about
`r sgn((exp(s_best$slope) - 1) * 100)`% wheat biomass per extra gram of fava; 95% CI
`r ci_txt(s_best$lo, s_best$hi, 2)`, p `r fmt_p(s_best$p)`). Adjusting for inoculation leaves it
essentially unchanged (`r sgn(s_best_adj$slope, 2)`, p `r fmt_p(s_best_adj$p)`), which makes sense
because fava and inoculation are only weakly related in the corrected data. The most influential
pot at this water level is pot `r inf$Pot` (wheat `r round(inf$W_NPP, 1)` g, fava
`r round(inf$Fava_g, 2)` g); without it the slope is `r sgn(s_drop$slope, 2)` per g (p
`r fmt_p(s_drop$p)`), so the direction holds but the size depends partly on that one pot. This is the usual
signature of two plants competing for the same pot, but it is a correlation in one of three water
levels, unadjusted, and fava biomass also depends on the pot, so it cannot be read as fava causing a
wheat loss.

# 3b. Simple effects: water within each inoculation level (EXPLORATORY)

Section 1 compares inoculated with sterile wheat *within* each water level. This section adds the
other direction, water contrasts *within* inoculated and within sterile pots, and repeats the full
set for fava's share of pot biomass (`Pot_pcent_fava`, a proportion 0-1). The models are
`lm(y ~ Inoculation * Water)` on the 30 intercrop pots for three responses: fava in grams, log(fava)
as a check, and fava share. All contrasts, with raw and Holm-adjusted p-values, are written to
`outputs/fava_simple_effects.csv`. Holm families: (a) the three Inoc - Strl contrasts for one
response; (b) the three pairwise water contrasts within one inoculation level for one response.

```{r simple-effects}
se_resp <- c(`Fava biomass (g)` = "Fava_g", `log(fava biomass)` = "log(Fava_g)",
             `Fava share of pot biomass` = "Pot_pcent_fava")
se_models <- map(se_resp, ~ lm(as.formula(paste(.x, "~ Inoc * Water")), data = inter))

anova_tab <- imap_dfr(se_models, function(m, r)
  car::Anova(m, type = 2) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    filter(term != "Residuals") %>% transmute(response = r, term, F = `F value`, df = Df, p = `Pr(>F)`))
knitr::kable(anova_tab %>% mutate(F = round(F, 2), p = signif(p, 2)),
             caption = "Type II ANOVA, lm(y ~ Inoc * Water), intercrop pots (n = 5 per cell)")

cellm <- inter %>% group_by(Inoc, Water) %>%
  summarise(`fava (g)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", mean(Fava_g), sd(Fava_g) / sqrt(n())),
            `fava share (%)` = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", 100 * mean(Pot_pcent_fava), 100 * sd(Pot_pcent_fava) / sqrt(n())),
            .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(cellm, caption = "Cell means ± SE (n = 5)")

contr <- function(m, r) {
  a <- emmeans(m, ~ Inoc | Water) %>% contrast("pairwise", adjust = "none") %>%
    summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(response = r, family = "a: Inoc vs Strl within water", within = as.character(Water),
              contrast, estimate, lo = lower.CL, hi = upper.CL, p_raw = p.value)
  b <- emmeans(m, ~ Water | Inoc) %>% contrast("pairwise", adjust = "none") %>%
    summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(response = r, family = "b: water within inoculation", within = as.character(Inoc),
              contrast, estimate, lo = lower.CL, hi = upper.CL, p_raw = p.value)
  bind_rows(a, b) %>% group_by(response, family, if_else(grepl("^b", family), within, "")) %>%
    mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p_raw, "holm")) %>% ungroup() %>% select(response:p_holm)
}
simple <- imap_dfr(se_models, contr) %>%
  mutate(scale = case_when(response == "log(fava biomass)" ~ "log (difference of logs)",
                           response == "Fava share of pot biomass" ~ "proportion (0-1)",
                           TRUE ~ "grams"))
write.csv(simple, "outputs/fava_simple_effects.csv", row.names = FALSE)

show <- simple %>% filter(grepl("^b", family) | response == "Fava share of pot biomass")
knitr::kable(show %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, lo, hi), ~ round(.x, 3)),
                             across(c(p_raw, p_holm), ~ signif(.x, 2))),
             caption = "EXPLORATORY - water contrasts within each inoculation level (all responses), and Inoc - Strl for fava share. Inoc - Strl for fava grams and log(fava) is in section 1.")

sig_b <- simple %>% filter(grepl("^b", family), response == "Fava biomass (g)", p_holm < 0.05)
fs <- simple %>% filter(response == "Fava share of pot biomass", grepl("^a", family))
fs_sev <- fs %>% filter(within == "Severe")
```

**Reading it.** For fava grams, `r nrow(sig_b)` of the six water contrasts within an inoculation
level survive Holm adjustment`r if (nrow(sig_b) > 0) paste0(" (", paste0(sig_b$within, ": ", sig_b$contrast, ", ", sgn(sig_b$estimate, 2), " g, Holm p ", sapply(sig_b$p_holm, fmt_p), collapse = "; "), ")") else ""`.
For fava's share of the pot, inoculated minus sterile is
`r paste0(sgn(100 * fs$estimate, 1), " points", collapse = ", ")` at control, moderate and
severe water (raw p `r paste(signif(fs$p_raw, 2), collapse = ", ")`; severe Holm p
`r fmt_p(fs_sev$p_holm)`).

# 4. Caveats (attach to any use of this file)

1. **Inoculum confound.** Inoculated pots received live INVAM material (spores, hyphae, root fragments,
   carrier, co-introduced microbiota); sterile pots received nothing. Any fava response to
   "inoculation" could be a direct inoculum effect on fava rather than an effect mediated by wheat's
   AMF. There is no killed-inoculum control. Sterile pots also had some background colonization.
2. **Fava's own colonization is unmeasured.** Fava roots were not stained, and nodulation was seen
   but never quantified, so no AMF-rhizobia mechanism can be tested here.

# 5. Figure (EXPLORATORY)

Encoding follows `fig_style.R`: blue = intercrop stand, filled = inoculated, open = sterile.
(A) Fava biomass, model geometric means with 95% CI and the % change with inoculation. (B) Wheat,
fava and total pot biomass on one axis (grams), with the difference in grams (bold when its CI
excludes zero). (C) Wheat biomass against fava biomass, by water, with the pooled fit and 95% CI.

```{r figure, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=12, dpi=150}
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
DODGE <- 0.6; OFF <- DODGE / 4
col <- pal_poly[["Inter"]]
legend_inoc <- function() list(
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Inoc = 21, Strl = 21), labels = inoc_lab),
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Inoc = col, Strl = "white"), labels = inoc_lab),
  guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.4, colour = col)),
         fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.4, colour = col))))
ttl <- theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
             plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 8.8))

# ---- A: fava biomass ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mm_a <- emmeans(lm(log_fava ~ Inoc * Water, data = inter), ~ Inoc | Water) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(Water = factor(Water, levels(inter$Water)), Inoc = factor(Inoc, levels(inter$Inoc)),
            fit = exp(emmean), lo = exp(lower.CL), hi = exp(upper.CL))
brk_a <- inter %>% group_by(Water) %>% summarise(top = max(fava), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(mm_a %>% group_by(Water) %>% summarise(ci_hi = max(hi), .groups = "drop"), by = "Water") %>%
  mutate(top = pmax(top, ci_hi), xn = as.numeric(Water),
         ybar = top * 1.10, ytick = top * 1.04, ylab_ = ybar * 1.04) %>%
  left_join(fl %>% select(Water, pct, pct_lo, pct_hi, lo, hi), by = "Water") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(sgn(pct), "%  (", ci_txt(pct_lo, pct_hi), ")"), sig = clear(lo, hi))

fig_a <- ggplot(inter, aes(x = Water, y = fava)) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_a, aes(x = xn - OFF, xend = xn + OFF, y = ybar, yend = ybar), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_a, aes(x = xn - OFF, xend = xn - OFF, y = ybar, yend = ytick), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_a, aes(x = xn + OFF, xend = xn + OFF, y = ybar, yend = ytick), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = brk_a, aes(x = xn, y = ylab_, label = label, colour = sig, fontface = ifelse(sig, "bold", "plain")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2, vjust = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey15", `FALSE` = "grey60"), guide = "none") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Inoc), colour = col, size = 2.1, stroke = 0.9, fill = NA, alpha = 0.75,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.10, dodge.width = DODGE, seed = 1)) +
  geom_linerange(data = mm_a, aes(y = fit, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, group = Inoc), colour = col,
                 linewidth = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = DODGE)) +
  geom_point(data = mm_a, aes(y = fit, shape = Inoc, fill = Inoc), colour = col, size = 3.4, stroke = 1.1,
             position = position_dodge(width = DODGE)) +
  legend_inoc() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = water_lab) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(brk_a$ylab_) * 1.12), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fava biomass per plant (g)", title = "Fava biomass",
       subtitle = paste0("% change with inoculated vs sterile wheat (95% CI). Inoculation x water: p ",
                         fmt_p(fl$p_interaction[1]), ".")) +
  theme_ms(11) + ttl + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

# ---- B: pot components in grams ----------------------------------------------------------------
cell_means <- map_dfr(c(Wheat = "wheat", Fava = "fava", `Total pot` = "pot"), function(v) {
  emmeans(lm(reformulate("Inoc * Water", v), data = inter), ~ Inoc | Water) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(Water = factor(Water, levels(inter$Water)), Inoc = factor(Inoc, levels(inter$Inoc)),
              mean = emmean, lo = lower.CL, hi = upper.CL)
}, .id = "comp") %>% mutate(comp = factor(comp, c("Wheat", "Fava", "Total pot")))
gram_lab <- gram_eff %>%
  mutate(comp = factor(unname(c(`Fava biomass` = "Fava", `Wheat biomass (pot total)` = "Wheat",
                                `Total pot biomass` = "Total pot")[response]), c("Wheat", "Fava", "Total pot")),
         sig = clear(lo, hi))
pts_b <- inter %>% select(Water, Inoc, Wheat = wheat, Fava = fava, `Total pot` = pot) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Wheat, Fava, `Total pot`), names_to = "comp", values_to = "y") %>%
  mutate(comp = factor(comp, c("Wheat", "Fava", "Total pot")))
brk_c <- pts_b %>% group_by(comp, Water) %>% summarise(top = max(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(cell_means %>% group_by(comp, Water) %>% summarise(ci_hi = max(hi), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("comp", "Water")) %>% mutate(top = pmax(top, ci_hi)) %>%
  mutate(xn = as.numeric(Water), ybar = top + 2.2, ytick = top + 0.9, ylab_ = ybar + 0.6) %>%
  left_join(gram_lab %>% select(comp, Water, est, sig), by = c("comp", "Water")) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(sgn(est, 1), " g"))
comp_lab <- c(Wheat = "Wheat (6 plants)", Fava = "Fava (1 plant)", `Total pot` = "Total pot")
water_short <- c(Control = "Control\n80% FC", Moderate = "Moderate\n60% FC", Severe = "Severe\n40% FC")

fig_b <- ggplot(pts_b, aes(x = Water, y = y)) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_c, aes(x = xn - OFF, xend = xn + OFF, y = ybar, yend = ybar), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_c, aes(x = xn - OFF, xend = xn - OFF, y = ybar, yend = ytick), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_c, aes(x = xn + OFF, xend = xn + OFF, y = ybar, yend = ytick), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = brk_c, aes(x = xn, y = ylab_, label = label, colour = sig, fontface = ifelse(sig, "bold", "plain")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.9, vjust = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey15", `FALSE` = "grey60"), guide = "none") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Inoc), colour = col, size = 1.6, stroke = 0.8, fill = NA, alpha = 0.7,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.10, dodge.width = DODGE, seed = 1)) +
  geom_linerange(data = cell_means, aes(y = mean, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, group = Inoc), colour = col,
                 linewidth = 0.55, position = position_dodge(width = DODGE)) +
  geom_point(data = cell_means, aes(y = mean, shape = Inoc, fill = Inoc), colour = col, size = 2.8, stroke = 1,
             position = position_dodge(width = DODGE)) +
  legend_inoc() +
  facet_wrap(~ comp, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(comp = comp_lab)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = water_short) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(brk_c$ylab_) * 1.1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Biomass per pot (g)", title = "Pot composition",
       subtitle = "Same axis in every panel. Labels: change with inoculation (g); bold if the 95% CI excludes zero.") +
  theme_ms(11) + ttl +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.5, lineheight = 0.9), panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"),
        legend.position = "none")

fig <- fig_a / fig_b + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
print(fig)
ggsave("figures/Fig_FavaNeighbor.png", fig, width = 7.5, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Pot composition, stacked bars (EXPLORATORY)

Each bar is the mean pot, wheat (bottom) plus fava (top), for inoculated and sterile pots at each
water level (identity-scale cell means, the same models as panel B). Open circles are each pot's
**total** biomass. The bracket gives the unadjusted p-value for the inoculated vs sterile difference
in total pot biomass (`gram_eff`); it is grey when the 95% CI includes zero.

```{r pot-composition, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4.6, dpi=150}
stack <- cell_means %>% filter(comp %in% c("Wheat", "Fava")) %>%
  mutate(comp = factor(comp, c("Fava", "Wheat")))            # first level is stacked on top

brk_s <- inter %>% group_by(Water) %>% summarise(top = max(pot), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ybar = top + 2.2, ytick = top + 0.9, ylab_ = ybar + 0.7) %>%
  left_join(gram_lab %>% filter(comp == "Total pot") %>% select(Water, est, p, sig), by = "Water") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("p ", fmt_p(p)))

fig_stacked <- ggplot(stack, aes(x = Inoc, y = mean)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = comp), colour = col, width = 0.66, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = inter, aes(x = Inoc, y = pot), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 21, fill = "white",
             colour = "grey25", size = 1.9, stroke = 0.8,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 2)) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_s, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = ybar, yend = ybar), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_s, aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = ybar, yend = ytick), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = brk_s, aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = ybar, yend = ytick), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = brk_s, aes(x = 1.5, y = ylab_, label = label, colour = sig, fontface = ifelse(sig, "bold", "plain")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.1, vjust = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey15", `FALSE` = "grey60"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Wheat = col, Fava = scales::alpha(col, 0.28)), breaks = c("Wheat", "Fava"),
                    labels = c(Wheat = "Wheat (6 plants)", Fava = "Fava (1 plant)")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Water, nrow = 1, strip.position = "bottom", labeller = labeller(Water = water_lab)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = inoc_lab) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(brk_s$ylab_) * 1.1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Biomass per pot (g)", fill = NULL, title = "Pot composition",
       subtitle = "Bars: mean wheat + fava. Open circles: total biomass of each pot. Bracket: p-value for the change in total.",
       caption = "Exploratory. p-values unadjusted. n = 5 pots per group.") +
  theme_ms(11) + ttl +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = 10),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.spacing.x = unit(1.4, "lines"),
        plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey45", size = 8.5, hjust = 0))
print(fig_stacked)
ggsave("figures/Fig_FavaNeighbor_PotComposition.pdf", fig_stacked, width = 7.5, height = 4.6)
ggsave("figures/Fig_FavaNeighbor_PotComposition.png", fig_stacked, width = 7.5, height = 4.6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

knitr::kable(stack %>% select(Water, Inoc, comp, mean) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = comp, values_from = mean) %>%
               left_join(brk_s %>% select(Water, `Δ total (g)` = est, `p (total)` = p), by = "Water") %>%
               mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))),
             caption = "Segment means (g per pot) and the inoculated vs sterile change in total pot biomass")
```

## Fava biomass: inoculation x water interaction plot (EXPLORATORY)

Cell means ± SE of fava biomass (g per pot) in the 30 intercrop pots; faint points are individual
pots. The label above each water level is the unadjusted p-value for inoculated vs sterile, from
`lm(Fava_g ~ Inoc * Water)` (section 3b), bold when p < 0.05. The Type II ANOVA for this model is in
section 3b: Inoculation p `r fmt_p(anova_tab$p[anova_tab$response == "Fava biomass (g)" & anova_tab$term == "Inoc"])`,
Water p `r fmt_p(anova_tab$p[anova_tab$response == "Fava biomass (g)" & anova_tab$term == "Water"])`,
Inoculation × Water p `r fmt_p(anova_tab$p[anova_tab$response == "Fava biomass (g)" & anova_tab$term == "Inoc:Water"])`.

```{r inoc-water-plot, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4.6, dpi=150}
iw_means <- inter %>% group_by(Water, Inoc) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(Fava_g), se = sd(Fava_g) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
iw_lab <- simple %>% filter(response == "Fava biomass (g)", grepl("^a", family)) %>%
  transmute(Water = factor(within, levels(inter$Water)), p = p_raw, sig = p_raw < 0.05) %>%
  left_join(inter %>% group_by(Water) %>% summarise(top = max(Fava_g), .groups = "drop"), by = "Water") %>%
  mutate(label = paste("p", fmt_p(p)))
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.25)

fig_iw <- ggplot(iw_means, aes(Water, m, group = Inoc)) +
  geom_point(data = inter, aes(Water, Fava_g, group = Inoc, fill = Inoc), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 21, colour = col, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.35,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.25, seed = 3)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Inoc), colour = col, linewidth = 0.8, position = pd) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = m - se, ymax = m + se), colour = col, width = 0.08, linewidth = 0.6, position = pd) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Inoc), shape = 21, colour = col, size = 3.4, stroke = 1.1, position = pd) +
  geom_text(data = iw_lab, aes(x = Water, y = top + 0.3, label = label, colour = sig,
                               fontface = ifelse(sig, "bold", "plain")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.4, vjust = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +

ggsave("figures/Fig_FavaNeighbor_InocWater.png", fig_iw, width = 6.5, height = 4.6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## AMF colonization against fava biomass, by water and inoculation (SUPPLEMENTARY, EXPLORATORY)

Ported from the retired `19_AMF_vs_Fava.Rmd` (figure "4b"), now on the corrected fava weights.
Wheat root colonization (count of 100 grid intersects with any fungal structure, arbuscules or
vesicles) against the pot's fava biomass. One quasibinomial model per row,
`cbind(n, 100 - n) ~ Fava_g * Inoc + Water`, so each inoculation treatment has one fava slope shared
across water levels (the water columns only shift the lines). The p-values are those fava slopes
(`emtrends`), the same in every column. Non-causal: neither fava biomass nor colonization was
randomized. Sterile pots have little colonization (background contamination only), so the sterile
slopes are close to meaningless and shown for completeness; the inoculated slopes are the actual
test.

```{r amf-vs-fava, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=8}
amf_metrics <- c(hyph_n = "Any fungal structure", arb_n = "Arbuscules", ves_n = "Vesicles")
stopifnot(all(inter$hyph_n == 100 - inter$None))
amf_fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
amf_fit <- function(metric) {
  d <- inter; d$n <- d[[metric]]
  glm(cbind(n, 100 - n) ~ Fava_g * Inoc + Water, family = quasibinomial, data = d)
}
amf_m <- map(set_names(names(amf_metrics)), amf_fit)
amf_rel <- function(d) mutate(d, metric = factor(metric, names(amf_metrics), amf_metrics))

amf_slopes <- imap_dfr(amf_m, ~ as.data.frame(test(emtrends(.x, ~ Inoc, var = "Fava_g"))) %>% mutate(metric = .y))
knitr::kable(amf_slopes %>% transmute(metric = amf_metrics[metric], Inoc, `fava slope (logit per g)` = round(Fava_g.trend, 3),
                                      SE = round(SE, 3), p = signif(p.value, 3)),
             caption = "EXPLORATORY - fava slope on wheat colonization within each inoculation treatment (adjusted for water)")

amf_grid <- seq(min(inter$Fava_g), max(inter$Fava_g), length.out = 100)
amf_rng  <- inter %>% group_by(Inoc, Water) %>% summarise(lo = min(Fava_g), hi = max(Fava_g), .groups = "drop")
amf_lines <- imap_dfr(amf_m, ~ emmeans(.x, ~ Fava_g * Inoc * Water, at = list(Fava_g = amf_grid), type = "response") %>%
                        as.data.frame() %>% mutate(metric = .y)) %>%
  rename(any_of(c(response = "prob", lcl = "asymp.LCL", ucl = "asymp.UCL", lcl = "lower.CL", ucl = "upper.CL"))) %>%
  left_join(amf_rng, by = c("Inoc", "Water")) %>% filter(Fava_g >= lo, Fava_g <= hi) %>% amf_rel()
amf_pts <- inter %>% select(Inoc, Water, Fava_g, all_of(names(amf_metrics))) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(names(amf_metrics)), names_to = "metric", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(y = n / 100) %>% amf_rel()
amf_ann <- amf_slopes %>%
  mutate(txt = paste0(inoc_lab[as.character(Inoc)], " slope ", amf_fmt_p(p.value))) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>% summarise(label = paste(txt, collapse = "\n"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Water = factor("Control", levels(inter$Water))) %>% amf_rel()

fig_amf <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = amf_lines, aes(Fava_g, ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl, group = Inoc), fill = col, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(data = amf_lines, aes(Fava_g, response, linetype = Inoc), colour = col, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = amf_pts, aes(Fava_g, y, fill = Inoc), shape = 21, colour = col, size = 2.8, stroke = 1) +
  geom_text(data = amf_ann, aes(x = Inf, y = 1.3, label = label), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1,
            size = 3, colour = "grey25", lineheight = 0.95) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ Water, labeller = labeller(Water = water_lab)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Inoc = col, Strl = "white"), labels = inoc_lab, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = lty_inoc, labels = inoc_lab, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.3), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Fava biomass (g per pot)", y = "Proportion of 100 root intersects",
       title = "AMF colonization against fava biomass, by water level and inoculation",
       subtitle = "Per pot, n = 5 per symbol group per panel. Lines and 95% CI from one model per row (fava x inoculation + water).") +
  theme_ms(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30"))
print(fig_amf)
ggsave("figures/Fig_FavaNeighbor_AMFvsFava_ByWater.pdf", fig_amf, width = 10.5, height = 8)
ggsave("figures/Fig_FavaNeighbor_AMFvsFava_ByWater.png", fig_amf, width = 10.5, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
